title: Personal services and negative injunctions
summary: Remedies concerning people’s labor raise different problems from transfer of goods.
notes: The discussion distinguishes an affirmative order compelling service from a negative order restraining inconsistent conduct. The actual burden and practical effect still matter. The examples involving performers and athletes should be read through those differences rather than reduced to the proposition that personal-service promises have no remedies.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 29–30. Open assigned page 29.
